purpose: 5-question plain-Swahili probe on never-seen phrasing: (a) regression-check Defects A+B and p02 on both live paths; (b) gather v15-vs-v16 evidence for the v16 wiring decision.
method: Each question run through BOTH live paths on the same Modal deployment / same v15 weights: v15 = production web_endpoint (classify+decompose+RAG+chat-template+clean, {message}->{reply}); v16 = Orchestrator(LocalAdapter->generate_endpoint) + AfriqueLlama tokenizer prompt-parity + shared v15 RAG index. Adjudicated against scripts/locked_facts.json + rules engine.

headline.defect_ab_regression: PASS 10/10 non-empty (both paths, all 5). No clean_reply blanking, no leading-echo re-blank on fresh unpunctuated plain-Swahili phrasing. Defects A+B hold.
headline.v15_vs_v16: 4/5 questions BYTE-IDENTICAL between v15 and v16 (all fact-routed). The one compute question (b02) DIVERGED decisively: v15 (no compute path) emitted a confident WRONG payroll number; v16 routed compute[sdl] and SAFE-CLARIFIED (no wrong number). => v16 >= v15 everywhere here, strictly safer on the compute question, zero fact-path regression.
headline.dominant_residual_failure: RETRIEVAL fragility (item-4), shared by BOTH paths (same index) and ORTHOGONAL to the wiring decision: b05 (GN487A fronting) missed the facilitation facts entirely -> inadequate answer; b01 top-3 also off-topic but rescued by general knowledge. Good retrieval (b04 rank-1 on-topic) -> good answer. Retrieval quality tracked answer quality 1:1.
new_findings_not_fixed: b05 GN487A facilitation retrieval miss: the fronting/name-lending facts exist (gn487a_license_lending_is_facilitation, gn487a_penalty_citizen_facilitator) but were NOT retrieved on this friendly-partnership phrasing; both paths gave a generic immigration-ownership answer that misses the criminal-facilitation exposure. Correctness failure driven by retrieval, not routing.

b02 slot-extraction gap on all-Swahili numerals: routing correctly reached compute[sdl], but the extractor did not resolve the fully-specified figures ('kumi na wawili'=12, 'laki tatu na nusu'=350,000 each, explicit 'kila mmoja') -> safe-clarify instead of the engine's 147,000. Compute path is only as good as the downstream Swahili-numeral extractor.

v16_wiring_evidence_summary.no_fact_path_regression: 4/4 fact-routed questions produced byte-identical v15/v16 answers on the same weights+index. Wiring v16 carries no regression risk on the fact path; it only ADDS the compute route + never-guess.
v16_wiring_evidence_summary.compute_path_is_strictly_safer: b02: v15 confident-wrong number vs v16 safe-clarify. This is the concrete case the v16 architecture (deterministic rules engine + never-guess) exists to fix.
v16_wiring_evidence_summary.retrieval_is_the_independent_top_lever: The two real content failures (b05 wrong, b01 rescued) are RETRIEVAL misses shared by both paths. v16 wiring will NOT fix them; the parked item-4 hybrid dense+lexical retrieval work is the lever. Wiring decision and item-4 are independent workstreams.
v16_wiring_evidence_summary.downstream_compute_extractor_is_next_aft: b02 shows routing-to-compute now works, but Swahili-numeral slot extraction ('kumi na wawili', 'laki tatu na nusu', per-person 'kila mmoja') did not resolve -> the engine's 147,000 was not delivered. The compute path's value is gated on extractor coverage.
